name: firmcode
description: Firmcode monorepo for AI-powered pull request review and testing.

scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace @firmcode/shared && npm run build --workspace @firmcode/prompts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @firmcode/shared && npm run build --workspace @firmcode/prompts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && python3 -m pytest apps/worker/tests
